description: When a title offers Resume, and where it resumes, from its `user` as the server answers it: any position above 0, watched before or not (a watched title being watched again keeps `played` and gets a resume point). `expected` is the position to resume at, or null for none. Checked by the Apple apps (ResumeRulesCasesTests), the Android apps (ResumeRulesCasesTest) and the Windows app (SharedCasesTests).

cases.name: Watched before, started again and stopped part way
Under a second counts: the rule is above 0
Position 0 and watched: finished, the server cleared the resume point
